newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas, GdesEaux news conf Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Havas, GdesEaux news conf Thurs.

text.p: Generale des Eaux and Havas said they would hold a news conference from 1530 GMT on Thursday at which the respective chairmen, Jean-Marie Messier and Pierre Dauzier, would be present.

They announced the news conference in a joint statement but not detail the subject. However, they said on Monday that they were set to make an announcement on their interests in the audiovisual industry, especially their stakes in Canal Plus.
The board of Generale des Eaux will meet on Thursday morning and Havas has a board meeting in the afternoon.
Industry sources have said that Generale des Eaux was likely to transfer its 19 percent stake in Canal Plus to Havas and would take a bigger stake, of between 25 and 30 percent, in Havas in return.
Part of this increased stake would be bought from Alcatel Alsthom.
The Le Figaro newspaper said on Wednesday that Generale des Eaux could also tranfer its Generale des Images media unit to Havas.

The paper said Messier had proposed to Belgian businessman Albert Frere and his Groupe Bruxelles-Lambert company to buy the remainder of Alcatel's stake in Havas, but Frere would have declined this offer.
